title: Captured weight and boundary leakage bound the error of sample-based spectral functions — reproduction repository
description: Reproduction deposit for N. Bonilla Vargas, Captured weight and boundary leakage bound the error of sample-based spectral functions, arXiv:2608.16436 (v3). It contains the manuscript sources (main text and Supplemental Material), every computation script, the deposited data behind every figure and quoted number, and an automated guardian (python src/verify.py, 868 checks over 9,884 numeric assertions) that recomputes the underlying physics by exact diagonalization and checks the deposit against it. Code under the MIT licence; manuscript, data and documentation under CC BY 4.0. Known gaps are listed in docs/KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md.
